name: Snow Report 2026-11-24 05:25:00
report:
Guess what all you skiers & snowboarders? The long wait is almost over... Snowbird opens tomorrow!

Resort Update:

All uphill travel is CLOSED for snowmaking and winter 2026-27 on-mountain preparation. Snowbird is scheduled to open for lift-serviced operations on November 25.

Mountain Report:
One more sleep. Opening Day at Snowbird is tomorrow, Wednesday, November 25, with first chair at 9 am.

The Aerial Tram, Little Cloud, Gadzoom, Wilbere and Chickadee are scheduled to run, conditions permitting. Check the Snowbird app tomorrow morning for the latest official lift and terrain information before heading up.

See you in the morning!

Give me The Bird.

report:

All uphill travel is CLOSED for snowmaking and winter 2026-27 on-mountain preparation. Snowbird is scheduled to open for lift-serviced operations on November 25.

Mountain Report:

Season Passholders, don't forget about your Early Bird Benefit (Passholder's who bought/renewed by May 13). Your free night at The Cliff Lodge is valid through December 17. The first couple of weekends of ski season are always exciting ones, so get your stay on the books while availability allows.

Mountain Report:

Another 5 inches overnight! Yesterday started out windy but by afternoon the winds had calmed down enough to let our snow-making crews join in on the fun and add some of their own snow to the natural flakes falling. 

And for all you Season Passholders, today (11/21) is Pre-Season Passholder Appreciation Day! Come on up between 11 am to 2 pm to build some preseason stoke, pick up your season pass and UDOT sticker (we are 100% back in snow tire season) and get your skis or snowboard waxed by our friends at Board Budder. Passholder Appreciation Day details

After a day of skiing, spend Thanksgiving at Snowbird. Bring the family, make a reservation and leave the cooking and cleanup to us.

And Season Passholders, don't forget about your Early Bird Benefit (Passholder's who bought/renewed by May 13). Your free night at The Cliff Lodge is valid through December 17. The first couple of weekends of ski season are always exciting ones, so get your stay on the books while availability allows.

The mountain is white. Snowmaking is underway. Opening Day is getting closer.

Mountain Report:

The brief break is over and snow has returned to the canyon, delivering 9 inches since last report and 5 inches overnight. The storm picked back up mid-morning yesterday and continued throughout the day and last night. There's a lot of wind with this event, so don't let the snow stake fool you! If you haven't already, it's time to wax those skis and get those snow tires on your car. We hope to see you at Opening Day on Black Friday, November 27, conditions permitting.
